guaranteeBanner.title: Join the homeowners who have chosen the security of our $250,000 guarantee
guaranteeBanner.subtitle: We understand the trust you place in contractors when you invite them into your space. That's why we've created the most comprehensive protection program in the industry.

howToUse.question: How do I use GU?
howToUse.answer: Search for your project type and location, compare verified contractors, and hire with confidence under our protection program.

howDifferent.question: How are GU contractors different?
howDifferent.answer: All contractors on GU are verified, financially evaluated, and backed by our guarantee to protect homeowners.

noContractors.question: What if there are no contractors in my area?
noContractors.answer: We are expanding rapidly. If none are listed, leave your information and we will notify you as soon as verified contractors are available.

cost.question: How much does it cost?
cost.answer: Using GU is free for homeowners. Contractors may have membership fees, but your protection is always included.

guaranteeCover.question: What does the $250,000 guarantee cover?
guaranteeCover.answer: It covers eligible losses such as contractor abandonment, poor workmanship, or damages caused during the project, up to the specified limit.
